title: select_channel formula mismatch with spec
description:
Line 59 uses `1 + (h % (n - 1))` but test vectors (ccp16.json, ccp_select_channel_endianness.json) expect `1 + (h % n)`. Test 'synchronized_hop_channel_consistency' returns 1 but expects 2. Same bug on line 202 in standalone function.

File: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py
Line: 59
close_reason: Fixed select_channel formula in ccp.py (line 97-98) and channel_plan.py (lines 59, 202): changed 'n = max(n_channels - 1, 2); return 1 + (h % n)' to 'n = max(n_channels, 3); return 1 + (h % n)' per spec. All 58 test_ccp.py tests now pass.
